title: Axisymmetric rectangular winding section
description: Draw a radial/axial winding rectangle at positive radius, place a winding label and model the full revolution about r=0. The graphical preview is a generic cross-section; its dimensions are explicit parameters, not copied from every cited device.

parameters.name: inner_radius
parameters.description: Radial position of the winding inner surface; nonnegative.

parameters.name: axial_length
parameters.description: Length of the winding along z.

constraints: An axisymmetric winding represents circumferential current, not a planar extrusion.

verification.note: Used by article-level, machine-component or new-design assemblies that passed natively; applicability limits still apply.

parameters.name: turns
parameters.description: Signed turns; a nonzero integer, used only with a circuit

title: Finite-difference inductance about magnet bias
description: For the woofer example, solve the same coil position with zero and nonzero current and divide the linkage difference by the current difference. This removes fixed magnet linkage from the estimated self-inductance.

parameters.name: delta_current
parameters.description: Chosen finite perturbation about the magnet-established operating point.

inputs: Two matching position snapshots and their current/linkage pairs
constraints: The perturbation must be checked for adequacy in nonlinear steel.
Total linkage divided by coil current includes magnet bias and is not the desired incremental inductance.

verification.note: Procedure curated from the cited official FEMM example(s); this library entry has not been numerically rerun.

title: Inductance from circuit flux linkage
description: Read the winding current and total flux linkage from circuit properties and compute L = linkage/current for the explicitly linear single-source regime.

parameters.name: current
parameters.description: Nonzero winding current used for linkage/current.

inputs: Solved linear model and circuit name
outputs: Self-inductance in H and winding quantities
constraints: A permanent-magnet bias or other independently excited coil invalidates the simple quotient for self-inductance.
Saturation requires a stated apparent or incremental definition.

verification.note: Procedure curated from the cited official FEMM example(s); this library entry has not been numerically rerun.

title: Parameterized air-core coil inductance and Wheeler comparison
description: Programmatically construct an arbitrary cylindrical air-core winding, solve at one ampere, read circuit linkage and compare selected dimensions with the applicable empirical Wheeler formula.
outputs: Native model, mesh and magnetic solution
Self-inductance in H and winding quantities
constraints: The source Octave function uses inches and an explicit one-ampere circuit.
The empirical formula has its own geometry applicability and is not an exact reference.
